paper_title: Production of dark matter axions from collapse of string-wall systems
notes: Cosmological dark-matter-overproduction bound on the axion decay constant from field-theoretic lattice simulations of axion production by string-wall network collapse (post-inflationary PQ breaking, N_DW=1). Eq. (95): Omega_a,tot h^2 = (8.4 +/- 3.0) (Fa/10^12 GeV)^1.19 (g*=70, Lambda=400 MeV); requiring this not exceed Omega_CDM h^2 = 0.11 gives Eq. (96): Fa <~ (2.0-3.8)e10 GeV. Reported here as the central value Fa = 2.6e10 GeV, i.e. a lower-bound/exclusion line at 1/f_a = 3.8e-11 GeV^-1 (region with smaller 1/f_a, larger Fa, excluded), drawn as a flat line up to the QCD axion mass at this Fa, m_a = 5.7 ueV x (1e12 GeV/Fa) = 2.2e-4 eV; the quoted (2.0-3.8)e10 range spans 1/f_a = 2.6e-11 to 5.0e-11 GeV^-1, all within a factor 2 of the central value. Not a statistical confidence limit: the 0.95 entry is nominal, the range reflects the +/-50% scaling-parameter (xi) uncertainty. No local DM density assumed (bound uses the cosmological abundance Omega_CDM h^2 = 0.11). No figure gives this as a curve; values taken from Eqs. (95)-(96) and Conclusion (v3 text, which incorporates the published corrections).
